title: Edge-Centric Federated Learning for LLMs in Smart Manufacturing: Architectures, Challenges, and Opportunities
note: FL for distributed training across sensors/robots/PLCs; FM (LLMs applied to IIoT for fault diagnosis and predictive maintenance); PdM (explicitly covers predictive maintenance, fault diagnosis, quality control in manufacturing). Survey paper but covers all three dimensions with industrial time-series sensor context.

title: Brain-Like Cognition-Driven Model Factory for IIoT Fault Diagnosis by Combining LLMs With Small Models
note: FL (vertical federated learning for IIoT nodes); FM (LLM as supervisor generating personalized diagnostic models from heterogeneous sensor data); PdM (fault diagnosis with maintenance recommendations for smart manufacturing, evaluated on 4 IIoT datasets). LLM is applied to industrial sensor/time-series data, not just NLP.
